 function render(){ensurePage();const b=q('#ghV47DiagBody');if(!b)return;const list=check();b.innerHTML='<div class="ghV47Hero"><small style="color:#6be9ff;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.12em">DEVICE / RUNTIME HEALTH</small><h2>この端末で何が動いているか確認</h2><p>ゲームデータを削除せず、ブラウザ機能とGolden Horseの重要マーカーだけを確認します。</p></div><div class="ghV47Grid"></div><div class="ghV47Errors"><h3>このページを開いてからのエラー</h3><div id="ghV47ErrorList"></div></div><div class="ghV47Actions"><button class="gold" data-v47-refresh>再チェック</button><button data-v47-fx>演出を再初期化</button></div>';const g=q('.ghV47Grid',b);list.forEach(([n,c,d])=>{const x=document.createElement('div');x.className='ghV47Check '+c;x.innerHTML=`<b>${n}：${c==='ok'?'OK':c==='bad'?'NG':'注意'}</b><small>${d}</small>`;g.appendChild(x)});const el=q('#ghV47ErrorList',b);el.innerHTML=errors.length?errors.slice().reverse().map(e=>`<div class="ghV47Err">${e.at} / ${e.kind}<br>${e.msg}</div>`).join(''):'<div class="ghV47Err">現在この診断画面で記録されたエラーはありません。</div>';q('[data-v47-refresh]',b).onclick=render;q('[data-v47-fx]',b).onclick=()=>{try{window.GH_V37_GOLDEN_PULSE_HQ?.ensureLotteryFX?.();window.GH_V37_GOLDEN_PULSE_HQ?.ensureGachaFX?.();window.GH_V43_SAFE_VISUAL_EVOLUTION?.refresh?.();window.GH_V46_SAFE_CINEMA_QUALITY?.apply?.();window.toast?.('演出を再初期化しました')}catch(e){pushError('reinit',e.message);render()}}}
 function boot(){ensurePage();document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest?.('[data-page="runtimeDiagnosticsSafe"]'))setTimeout(render,60)},true)}
 boot();window.GH_V47_SAFE_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTICS={build:BUILD,render,get errors(){return [...errors]},check};document.documentElement.dataset.ghV47='safe-runtime-diagnostics-r1';
})();
</script>


<style id="gh-v48-runtime-repair-style">#ghV48RepairBadge{position:fixed;right:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:2147483000;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #3a7187;background:#03131cdd;color:#9ceeff;font:700 9px/1.2 system-ui;pointer-events:none;opacity:.82}</style>
<script defer id="gh-v48-safe-runtime-repair-r1">
(()=>{'use strict';
 if(window.GH_V48_RUNTIME_REPAIR)return;
 const BUILD='V48-SAFE-RUNTIME-REPAIR-R1';
 const errors=[];
 window.addEventListener('error',e=>{errors.push({type:'error',message:String(e.message||''),file:String(e.filename||''),line:Number(e.lineno||0),time:Date.now()});if(errors.length>20)errors.shift()});
 window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',e=>{errors.push({type:'promise',message:String(e.reason?.message||e.reason||''),time:Date.now()});if(errors.length>20)errors.shift()});
 function badge(){let b=document.getElementById('ghV48RepairBadge');if(!b){b=document.createElement('div');b.id='ghV48RepairBadge';document.body.appendChild(b)}b.textContent='V48 / RUNTIME REPAIR';}
 function selfTest(){
   const h=document.documentElement.innerHTML;
   const v31=document.getElementById('gh-v31-safe-activity-continuity-r1')?.textContent||'';
   const v33=document.getElementById('gh-v33-safe-bonus-gold-conversion-r1')?.textContent||'';
   return {
     ok:!!window.GH_V31_ACTIVITY_CONTINUITY && !!window.GH_V33_BONUS_GOLD
       && !v31.includes('ensureToast()') && !v31.includes('ghV33BonusBody')
       && v31.includes("call('activity_state')")
       && v33.includes('function ensureToast()') && v33.includes("call('bonus_gold_state')")
       && h.includes('FIXED_BET_SECONDS=120') && !!document.getElementById('skipBtn') && h.includes('finalOddsSnapshot'),
     build:BUILD,
     activityScriptRestored:true,
     bonusGoldScriptRestored:true,
     runtimeErrors:errors.slice(),
     protectedRaceCore:true
   }
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',badge,{once:true});else badge();
 window.GH_V48_RUNTIME_REPAIR={build:BUILD,errors,selfTest};
 document.documentElement.dataset.ghV48='safe-runtime-repair-r1';
})();
</script>

<script defer id="gh-v49-cinema-visual-restore-r1">
(()=>{'use strict';
 if(window.GH_V49_CINEMA_VISUAL_RESTORE)return;

 renderHome=function(){

   const races=typeof state!=='undefined'?Number(state.todayRaces||0):0;

   setText('homeRaceNo',`第${raceNo}レース`);

   if(member&&(!member.textContent.trim()||member.textContent.trim()==='---'))member.textContent='体験モード';
 };
 renderHome();
 window.GH_V49_CINEMA_VISUAL_RESTORE=Object.freeze({build:BUILD,visualBase:'GOOD-07:01',runtimeBase:'V48',protected:Object.freeze({betSeconds:120,skipSync:true,oddsLock:true,serverFinishOrder:true})});
})();
</script>

<script defer id="gh-v50-safe-event-driven-stable-r1">
(()=>{'use strict';
 if(window.GH_V50_SAFE_EVENT_DRIVEN)return;
 const BUILD='V50-SAFE-EVENT-DRIVEN-STABLE-R1';
 const fire=(name,detail={})=>document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name,{detail}));
 let last=0;
 function refresh(reason='manual'){const now=Date.now();if(now-last<60)return;last=now;fire('gh:v50:refresh',{reason,at:now})}
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
   const t=e.target.closest?.('#drawBtn,[data-redraw],[data-v10-custom-redraw],[data-ghv23-lb],[data-ghv28-confirm],[data-ghv28-burst-close],[data-page],[data-gacha-tab]');
   if(!t)return;
   const draw=!!t.closest?.('#drawBtn,[data-redraw],[data-v10-custom-redraw]');
   const lb=!!t.closest?.('[data-ghv23-lb],[data-ghv28-confirm],[data-ghv28-burst-close]');
   setTimeout(()=>refresh(draw?'gacha':lb?'limitbreak':'navigation'),draw?1850:130);
   if(draw)setTimeout(()=>fire('gh:v50:gacha-result',{at:Date.now()}),2050);
   if(lb)setTimeout(()=>fire('gh:v50:limitbreak-refresh',{at:Date.now()}),180);
 },true);
 window.addEventListener('focus',()=>refresh('focus'));
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden)refresh('visible')});
 window.GH_V50_SAFE_EVENT_DRIVEN={build:BUILD,refresh,fire,watchersRemoved:['V40','V41','V42','V43','V45']};
 document.documentElement.dataset.ghV50='safe-event-driven-stable-r1';
 setTimeout(()=>refresh('boot'),1000);
})();
</script>

<script id="gh-v55-contained-gate-script">(()=>{'use strict';
const race=document.getElementById('raceScreen'),gate=document.getElementById('startGate'),phase=document.getElementById('racePhase');
if(!race||!gate||!phase||typeof window.buildRaceUI!=='function')return;
const previous=window.buildRaceUI;
function prepare(){
 const stalls=gate.querySelectorAll('#gateStalls>i');
 for(let i=0;i<Math.min(7,stalls.length);i++){
  const stall=stalls[i],runner=document.getElementById('runner'+(i+1));
  stall.querySelector('.ghGateHorse')?.remove();
  const art=runner?.querySelector('svg');if(!art||stall.classList.contains('scratched'))continue;
  const holder=document.createElement('span');holder.className='ghGateHorse';holder.style.setProperty('--ghGateDelay',String(i*105)+'ms');
  holder.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');holder.appendChild(art.cloneNode(true));stall.appendChild(holder);
 }
}
window.buildRaceUI=buildRaceUI=function(...args){const result=previous.apply(this,args);prepare();return result};
const update=()=>{
 const p=phase.textContent.trim();
 if(p==='GATE IN'||p==='ゲートイン'||p==='FINAL CHECK'||p==='FANFARE'||p==='READY')race.classList.add('ghGateEntered');
 else if(p==='BETTING CLOSED'||p==='PADDOCK TO GATE'||p==='各馬ゲートへ')race.classList.remove('ghGateEntered');
};
new MutationObserver(update).observe(phase,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});update();
window.GH_GATE_VISUAL_TEST=Object.freeze({prepare,audit(){const ss=[...gate.querySelectorAll('#gateStalls>i')];return {stalls:ss.length,contained:ss.filter(s=>s.classList.contains('scratched')||!!s.querySelector('.ghGateHorse>svg')).length,inGate:race.classList.contains('inGate'),entered:race.classList.contains('ghGateEntered')}}});
})();</script><style id="gh-v59-ui-only">

</style><script id="gh-v60-preview-ui">
/* UI only: reads existing DOM cards, delegates all actions to existing game buttons. */
(()=>{'use strict';
 function boot(){
  const menu=document.querySelector('#home>.menu'),more=menu?.querySelector('.gh-v59-more-grid');
  if(menu&&more){
   const moveAddedLinks=()=>{for(const button of menu.querySelectorAll(':scope > button[data-page]'))more.appendChild(button)};
   new MutationObserver(moveAddedLinks).observe(menu,{childList:true});
   moveAddedLinks();
  }
  const grid=document.getElementById('cardsGrid'),panel=document.getElementById('ghV60Selected');if(!grid||!panel)return;
  const art=document.getElementById('ghV60PreviewArt'),rarity=document.getElementById('ghV60Rarity'),name=document.getElementById('ghV60Name'),status=document.getElementById('ghV60EquipState'),detail=document.getElementById('ghV60Detail'),equip=document.getElementById('ghV60Equip');
  let chosen='';
  function refresh(){
   const items=Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.gameCard'));
   let current=items.find(el=>el.querySelector('[data-card]')?.getAttribute('data-card')===chosen)||items[0];
   items.forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('gh-v60-picked',el===current));
   if(!current){chosen='';name.textContent='所持カードがありません';rarity.textContent='コレクション';status.textContent='カードを入手すると表示されます。';detail.disabled=true;equip.disabled=true;art.style.backgroundImage='';return;}
   chosen=current.querySelector('[data-card]')?.getAttribute('data-card')||'';
   name.textContent=chosen;
   rarity.textContent=current.querySelector('.rare')?.textContent?.trim()||'所持カード';
   const active=!!current.querySelector('.equipState');
   status.textContent=active?'装備中 · 詳細から効果を確認できます':'所持中 · 装備すると効果が反映されます';
   const picture=current.style.getPropertyValue('--img');
   if(picture)art.style.backgroundImage=`linear-gradient(180deg,#100b0510,#100b0573),${picture}`;
   detail.disabled=false;equip.disabled=active;
   equip.textContent=active?'装備中':'装備する';
  }
  grid.addEventListener('click',e=>{
   const item=e.target.closest('.gameCard');if(!item)return;
   chosen=item.querySelector('[data-card]')?.getAttribute('data-card')||'';
   queueMicrotask(refresh);
  });
  detail.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   const target=Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('[data-card]')).find(el=>el.getAttribute('data-card')===chosen);target?.click();
  });
  equip.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   const target=Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('[data-manage-equip]')).find(el=>el.getAttribute('data-manage-equip')===chosen);if(target&&!target.disabled)target.click();
  });
  new MutationObserver(()=>queueMicrotask(refresh)).observe(grid,{childList:true});
  refresh();
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot,{once:true});else boot();
})();

<script defer id="gh-v64-top-race-unify-script">
(()=>{'use strict';
 function addTitle(el,text){if(!el||el.querySelector('.gh-v64-card-title'))return;const t=document.createElement('span');t.className='gh-v64-card-title';t.textContent=text;el.prepend(t)}
 function regroup(){
   const home=document.getElementById('home'); if(!home) return;
   let wrap=document.getElementById('ghV64HomeMeta');
   const util=document.querySelector('#home .ghV49Utility');
   if(!wrap){wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.id='ghV64HomeMeta';wrap.className='gh-v64-home-meta'; if(util) util.before(wrap); else home.appendChild(wrap)}
   [['ghV36GoldRule','Goldガイド'],['ghV44HomeBadge','進化ギャラリー'],['ghV46Quality','演出品質'],['ghV8RemoteStatus','運営設定']].forEach(([id,label])=>{const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el){if(el.parentElement!==wrap)wrap.appendChild(el); addTitle(el,label)}});
   const cloud=document.getElementById('cloudStatusBadge'); if(cloud&&util&&cloud.parentElement!==util) util.prepend(cloud);
   const empty=document.querySelector('#home #betSlips .emptyBet'); if(empty && !/投票を追加してください/.test(empty.textContent||'')) empty.innerHTML='まだ投票はありません。<div style="margin-top:5px;color:#a78750;font-size:11px">馬を選んで投票を追加してください</div>';
 }
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>setTimeout(regroup,250));
 window.addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(regroup,350));
 setTimeout(regroup,900);
})();
</script>

<script id="gh-v71-race-shortcuts">
(()=>{'use strict';
const destinations={ghV71JumpToBet:'#home .betPanel',ghV71JumpToHorses:'#home .odds'};
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{
 const button=event.target.closest('button#ghV71JumpToBet,button#ghV71JumpToHorses');
 if(!button||!document.getElementById('home')?.classList.contains('active'))return;
 const destination=document.querySelector(destinations[button.id]);
 if(destination)destination.scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant',block:'start'});
});
})();
</script>

<button type="button" id="gh-help-open" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="gh-help-dialog">？ ご質問・ご案内</button>
<div id="gh-help-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="gh-help-title" hidden>
 <div id="gh-help-panel" tabindex="-1">
  <h2 id="gh-help-title">お客さん安心サポート｜日本語のご案内</h2>
  <p>よくあるご質問と、画面操作やルールをご案内します。この画面は自動応答チャットではありません。AIがレースの当たり予想や買い目のおすすめをすることはありません。</p>
  <details><summary>遊び方を知りたい</summary><p>ホームから「遊び方」を開くと、レースの進行や各券種のルールを確認できます。実際のゲームは画面に表示される利用条件をご確認ください。</p></details>
  <details><summary>ログイン・会員登録で困った</summary><p>ホームの「マイログイン」から操作してください。暗証番号や認証コードは、この案内画面に入力しないでください。</p></details>
  <details><summary>ゴールド（Gold）・投票（BET）の履歴を確認したい</summary><p>ログイン後、本人用の残高・履歴画面を確認してください。この案内では残高変更、BET確定、払戻や抽選の操作は行いません。</p></details>
  <details><summary>レースの当たり予想について</summary><p>レースの当たり予想、勝ち馬の指定、予想や買い目のおすすめはしません。券種の一般的なルールのみ案内します。</p></details>
  <details><summary>音が出ない・小さい</summary><p>最初に画面の音声設定とスマホの音量・消音設定を確認してください。ブラウザでは、画面を一度タップするまで音が再生されない場合があります。急に大きな音が出ないよう、音量を下げてからお試しください。</p></details>
  <details><summary>画面やボタンが動かない</summary><p>通信状態を確認し、操作を連続で押さずに少しお待ちください。解決しない場合は、画面の表示内容を控えてスタッフにご相談ください。投票や残高の反映が不明なときは、二重の操作を避けてください。</p></details>
  <div id="gh-help-human" hidden><h3>人に相談する</h3><p>お店のスタッフに直接お声がけください。現在、この案内画面からの問い合わせ送信や受付番号の発行には対応していません。個人情報や認証コードをこの画面に入力しないでください。</p></div>
  <div id="gh-help-actions"><button type="button" id="gh-help-human-open" aria-expanded="false">人に相談</button><button type="button" id="gh-help-close">閉じる</button></div>
 </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){'use strict';
const open=document.getElementById('gh-help-open');
const dialog=document.getElementById('gh-help-dialog');
const close=document.getElementById('gh-help-close');
const human=document.getElementById('gh-help-human');
const humanBtn=document.getElementById('gh-help-human-open');
if(!open||!dialog||!close||!human||!humanBtn)return;
let lastFocus=null;
function show(){lastFocus=document.activeElement;dialog.hidden=false;open.hidden=true;close.focus();}
function hide(){dialog.hidden=true;open.hidden=false;human.hidden=true;humanBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');(lastFocus&&lastFocus.isConnected?lastFocus:open).focus();}
open.addEventListener('click',show);
close.addEventListener('click',hide);
humanBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){human.hidden=!human.hidden;humanBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!human.hidden));});
dialog.addEventListener('click',function(event){if(event.target===dialog)hide();});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){if(dialog.hidden)return;if(event.key === "Escape"){event.preventDefault();hide();return;}if(event.key==='Tab'){
 const focusable=Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button,summary')).filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length>0);
 if(!focusable.length)return;const first=focusable[0],last=focusable[focusable.length-1];
 if(event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){event.preventDefault();last.focus();}
 else if(!event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){event.preventDefault();first.focus();}
 }});
})();
</script>
<script id="gh-race-help-protection">
/* Independent UI safeguard: never cover race controls/map even on browsers without :has(). */
(()=>{'use strict';
 const race=document.getElementById('raceScreen');
 const button=document.getElementById('gh-help-open');
 const dialog=document.getElementById('gh-help-dialog');
 if(!race||!button||!dialog)return;
 let racing=false;
 function sync(){
   const active=race.classList.contains('on');
   if(active){
     button.hidden=true;
     dialog.hidden=true;
   } else if(racing){
     button.hidden=false;
   }
   racing=active;
 }
 new MutationObserver(sync).observe(race,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
 sync();
})();
</script>

@media(max-width:390px){#home>.raceCard .gh-v62-race-banner .gh-v76-venue-art{inset:0 0 0 31%;opacity:.50}#gh-v76-banner-city{margin-top:5px;font-size:9px;padding:3px 6px}}
</style>
<script id="gh-v76-venue-sync">
(function(){
'use strict';
function install(){
 const home=document.querySelector('#home'),hero=home?.querySelector('.hero'),banner=home?.querySelector('.gh-v62-race-banner'),label=document.getElementById('homeVenue');
 if(!home||!hero||!banner||!label||typeof VENUES==='undefined'||typeof VENUE_ART==='undefined')return;
 function layer(host,id){let el=host.querySelector('#'+id);if(!el){el=document.createElement('div');el.className='gh-v76-venue-art';el.id=id;el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');host.insertBefore(el,host.firstChild)}return el}
 const heroArt=layer(hero,'gh-v76-hero-art'),bannerArt=layer(banner,'gh-v76-banner-art');
 const copy=banner.querySelector('.gh-v62-banner-copy');
 let city=copy?.querySelector('#gh-v76-banner-city');
 if(copy&&!city){city=document.createElement('span');city.id='gh-v76-banner-city';copy.appendChild(city)}
 let current='';
 function syncVisual(){
  const shown=(label.textContent||'').trim();
  if(shown===current)return;
  const idx=VENUES.indexOf(shown);
  if(idx<0||!VENUE_ART[idx])return; // Never display the wrong city if a new venue is added elsewhere.
  for(const element of [heroArt,bannerArt]){element.innerHTML=VENUE_ART[idx].replace(/<text\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/text>/g,'');element.dataset.ghVenue=shown}
  if(city)city.textContent=shown;
  current=shown;
 }
 new MutationObserver(syncVisual).observe(label,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
 syncVisual();
 const entry=document.getElementById('startPage'),race=document.getElementById('raceScreen');
 function syncBetting(){document.body.classList.toggle('gh-v76-betting',!!(entry?.classList.contains('active')||race?.classList.contains('on')))}
 if(entry)new MutationObserver(syncBetting).observe(entry,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
 if(race)new MutationObserver(syncBetting).observe(race,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
 syncBetting();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
})();
</script>

Yamabe","license":"CC0"}];
 function install(){
  const home=document.querySelector('#home'),hero=home?.querySelector('.hero'),banner=home?.querySelector('.gh-v62-race-banner'),venue=document.getElementById('homeVenue');
  if(!hero||!banner||!venue||typeof VENUES==='undefined')return;
  const hosts=[{el:hero,id:'gh-v77-hero-photo'},{el:banner,id:'gh-v77-banner-photo'}];
  let activeCity='';
  function update(){
   const label=venue.textContent.trim();
   if(label===activeCity)return;
   const ix=VENUES.indexOf(label);if(ix<0||!photos[ix])return;
   // Do not leave the previous city photograph visible during slow image loading.
   const cfg=photos[ix];
   for(const host of hosts){
    host.el.querySelector('#'+host.id)?.remove();
    const img=document.createElement('img');
    img.id=host.id;img.className='gh-v77-photo';img.alt='';img.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    img.dataset.ghVenue=label;img.decoding='async';img.loading='eager';
    img.addEventListener('load',()=>{if(img.isConnected&&img.dataset.ghVenue===venue.textContent.trim())img.classList.add('is-loaded')},{once:true});
    img.addEventListener('error',()=>img.classList.remove('is-loaded'),{once:true});
    host.el.insertBefore(img,host.el.firstChild);
    img.src=cfg.url;
   }
   activeCity=label;
  }
  const race=document.getElementById('raceScreen');
  if(race&&!race.querySelector('.gh-v77-race-sheen')){
   const layer=document.createElement('div');layer.className='gh-v77-race-sheen';layer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');race.insertBefore(layer,race.firstChild);
  }
  new MutationObserver(update).observe(venue,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});
  update();
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
})();
</script>

<script id="gh-demo-mobile-horse-frame-js">
(function(){'use strict';
 function install(){
  if(typeof renderRacePositions!=='function'||window.__ghMobileHorseFrame)return;
  window.__ghMobileHorseFrame=true;
  const unchangedRender=renderRacePositions;
  renderRacePositions=function(){
   unchangedRender.apply(this,arguments);
   const stage=document.getElementById('raceScreen');
   if(!stage||!stage.classList.contains('on')||stage.classList.contains('inGate')||window.innerWidth>560)return;
   const width=stage.clientWidth;
   const runners=stage.querySelectorAll('#runners>.runner');
   for(const runner of runners){
    const desired=Number.parseFloat(runner.style.left);
    if(!Number.isFinite(desired))continue;
    const rendered=runner.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const leftPx=desired*width/100;
    const inset=Math.min(Math.max(8,width*.034),18);
    const safeRight=Math.max(inset,width-rendered-inset);
    const safeLeft=Math.max(inset,Math.min(safeRight,leftPx));
    if(leftPx!==safeLeft)runner.style.left=safeLeft+'px';
   }
  };
  renderRacePositions();
 }
 if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',install,{once:true});else install();
})();
</script>

<style id="gh-story-display-only-style">
/* Scoped, read-only layer outside the race engine and video/horse lanes. */
#ghStoryToggle{position:absolute;z-index:51;top:80px;left:60px;min-height:35px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #f5cc74b5;border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(130deg,#1e150dbb,#060608ef);color:#ffdf99;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.03em;box-shadow:0 2px 13px #000b}
#ghStoryRibbon{position:absolute;z-index:30;top:122px;left:10px;width:min(336px,calc(100vw - 20px));min-height:68px;box-sizing:border-box;pointer-events:none;border:1px solid #dbb4689c;border-left:3px solid #ffda77;border-radius:11px;padding:8px 11px;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#07090cdd,#241707c9);box-shadow:0 10px 22px #0007,inset 0 1px #ffe6a31a;overflow:hidden}
#ghStoryRibbon[hidden]{display:none!important}
#ghStoryRibbon:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 15%,#ffebaa0e 48%,transparent 70%);animation:gh-story-light 5s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes gh-story-light{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
#ghStoryRibbon .ghStoryEyebrow{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#e3bb79;letter-spacing:.12em}
#ghStoryRibbon .ghStoryHeadline{margin-top:2px;line-height:1.35;color:#fff5dc;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(12px,3.25vw,15px);text-shadow:0 1px 8px #000}
#ghStoryRibbon .ghStoryDetail{margin-top:2px;color:#e2d0ae;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em}
@media(max-width:420px){#ghStoryToggle{top:79px;left:58px;font-size:10px;min-height:31px}#ghStoryRibbon{top:119px;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px);min-height:63px;padding:6px 9px}#ghStoryRibbon .ghStoryHeadline{font-size:12px}#ghStoryRibbon .ghStoryDetail{font-size:9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#ghStoryRibbon:before{animation:none}}
</style>
<script id="gh-story-spectator-only-script">
(function(){'use strict';
/**
 * Golden Horse — read-only race storyline subtitles.
 * Reads already-present race snapshots. Never infers an unobserved event.
 * Pure function: no clock, RNG, bets, outcome or voice side effects.
 */
function buildStory(snapshot) {
  const x=snapshot||{};
  const order=x.order;
  if(!Array.isArray(order)||order.length<2||order.length>7||order.some(n=>!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>7)||new Set(order).size!==order.length)return null;
  const names=x.horseNames||{};
  const label=n=>`${n}番${typeof names[n]==='string'&&names[n].trim()?names[n]:''}`;
  const a=order[0],b=order[1],c=order[2];
  const place=`先頭 ${a}番 ／ 2番手 ${b}番${c?` ／ 3番手 ${c}番`:''}`;
  const phase=String(x.phase||'');
  const labels={gate:'発走前',start:'スタート',first:'第1コーナー',back:'向こう正面',corner:'最終コーナー',sprint:'最終直線',final:'残り200m',goal:'決勝線',photo:'写真判定'};
  const labelPhase=labels[phase];
  if(!labelPhase)return null;
  if(phase==='photo'&&!x.photo)return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:'ゴールの確認中',detail:'確定結果をお待ちください'};
  if(phase==='photo')return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:'写真判定へ',detail:'正式な着順を確認中'};
  if(phase==='goal')return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:'全馬、決勝線へ！',detail:x.photo?'接戦につき正式な着順を確認中':place};
  if(phase==='gate')return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:order.length===7?'7頭の物語、まもなく開幕':'各馬の物語、まもなく開幕',detail:'発走を待っています'};
  // Reuse ONLY events already marked live by the original event-driven director.
  // In particular, do not mistake static captions for actual race incidents.
  if(x.eventLive&&typeof x.eventText==='string'&&x.eventText.trim()){
    return {eyebrow:`実イベント ／ ${labelPhase}`,headline:x.eventText.trim().slice(0,44),detail:place};
  }
  // A comeback is announced only when this same horse was observed in front,
  // fell behind, then was observed retaking the lead during uninterrupted play.
  if(!x.skip&&['corner','sprint','final'].includes(phase)&&Array.isArray(x.previousOrder)&&x.previousOrder.length===order.length&&x.previousOrder[0]!==a&&x.previousOrder.includes(a)&&Array.isArray(x.leaderHistory)&&x.leaderHistory.includes(a)&&x.leaderHistory.includes(x.previousOrder[0])){
    return {eyebrow:`実測ハイライト ／ ${labelPhase}`,headline:`${label(a)}が先頭を奪い返す！`,detail:place};
  }
  if(!x.skip&&Array.isArray(x.previousOrder)&&x.previousOrder.length>=2&&x.previousOrder[0]!==a&&x.previousOrder.includes(a)&&phase!=='start'){
    return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:`先頭交代！ ${label(a)}が前へ`,detail:place};
  }
  if(!x.skip&&Array.isArray(x.previousOrder)&&x.previousOrder.length===order.length&&['back','corner','sprint','final'].includes(phase)) {
    const promoted=order.slice(0,3).find((id,i)=>{const old=x.previousOrder.indexOf(id);return i>0&&old>=4&&old-i>=3});
    if(promoted)return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:`後方から${label(promoted)}が浮上！`,detail:place};
  }
  const head={
    start:`${label(a)}が先頭へ！`,
    first:`${label(a)}、先頭で第1コーナーへ`,
    back:`${label(a)}が先頭を進む`,
    corner:`${label(a)}を${label(b)}が追う`,
    sprint:`残り400m！ ${label(a)}が先頭`,
    final:`残り200m！ ${label(a)}が先頭`
  };
  return {eyebrow:labelPhase,headline:head[phase]||`${label(a)}が先頭`,detail:place};
}

function mount(){
  const stage=document.getElementById('raceScreen');
  if(!stage||document.getElementById('ghStoryRibbon'))return;
  const toggle=document.createElement('button');toggle.id='ghStoryToggle';toggle.type='button';toggle.textContent='物語字幕 ON';toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');toggle.setAttribute('aria-label','物語字幕を表示・非表示');
  const ribbon=document.createElement('div');ribbon.id='ghStoryRibbon';ribbon.setAttribute('aria-live','off');ribbon.setAttribute('role','status');
  const eyebrow=document.createElement('div');eyebrow.className='ghStoryEyebrow';
  const headline=document.createElement('div');headline.className='ghStoryHeadline';
  const detail=document.createElement('div');detail.className='ghStoryDetail';
  ribbon.append(eyebrow,headline,detail);stage.append(toggle,ribbon);
  let enabled=true,oldPhase='',oldOrder=null,previousKey='',lastVisible='',leaderHistory=[];
  toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{enabled=!enabled;toggle.textContent='物語字幕 '+(enabled?'ON':'OFF');toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(enabled));ribbon.hidden=!enabled||!stage.classList.contains('on')});
  function readPhase(){
    let key='';try{key=String(raceState?.currentKey||'')}catch(_){}
    const phase=document.getElementById('racePhase')?.textContent||'';
    const cap=document.getElementById('phaseCaption')?.textContent||'';
    if(/写真判定/.test(phase+' '+cap))return 'photo';
    if(['gate','start','first','back','corner','sprint','final','goal'].includes(key))return key;
    if(/ゴール|GOAL/.test(phase))return 'goal';
    if(/200/.test(phase))return 'final';
    if(/最終直線|400/.test(phase))return 'sprint';
    if(/コーナー/.test(phase))return 'corner';
    if(/ゲート/.test(phase))return 'gate';
    return '';
  }
  function update(){
    if(!stage.classList.contains('on')){ribbon.hidden=true;oldOrder=null;oldPhase='';previousKey='';lastVisible='';leaderHistory=[];return;}
    ribbon.hidden=!enabled;
    if(!enabled)return;
    const phase=readPhase();if(!phase)return;
    let order=[],horseNames={},skip=false,photo=false;
    try{
      if(typeof currentOrder==='function')order=currentOrder();
      if(typeof raceName==='function'&&Array.isArray(order))order.forEach(n=>horseNames[n]=raceName(n));
      if(typeof raceState!=='undefined'){skip=!!raceState?.skipInProgress||!!raceState?.skipRequested;photo=!!raceState?.photo}
    }catch(_){return}
    const eventNode=document.getElementById('phaseCaption');
    const eventText=eventNode?.textContent||'';
    const eventLive=!!eventNode?.classList.contains('eventLive');
    // Never label a skipped jump as an overtaking event. Only compare consecutive snapshots within a phase.
    const prev=oldPhase===phase?oldOrder:null;
    // Only track leaders actually observed while racing: no pre-race labels or SKIP jumps.
    if(skip)leaderHistory=[];
    else if(['start','first','back','corner','sprint','final'].includes(phase)){
      if(!leaderHistory.length&&order.length)leaderHistory=[order[0]];
      if(prev&&prev[0]!==order[0]&&leaderHistory.at(-1)!==prev[0])leaderHistory.push(prev[0]);
    }
    const snap=buildStory({phase,order,previousOrder:prev,leaderHistory,horseNames,skip,photo,eventText,eventLive});
    if(!snap)return;
    const key=phase+'|'+order.join(',')+'|'+eventText+'|'+eventLive+'|'+photo;
    if(key===previousKey)return;
    previousKey=key;
    // Prevent poll repetition when an overtaking snapshot becomes its own previous snapshot.
    if(!lastVisible||snap.headline!==lastVisible||oldPhase!==phase){eyebrow.textContent=snap.eyebrow;headline.textContent=snap.headline;detail.textContent=snap.detail;lastVisible=snap.headline}
    oldPhase=phase;oldOrder=[...order];
    if(!skip&&['start','first','back','corner','sprint','final'].includes(phase)&&leaderHistory.at(-1)!==order[0])leaderHistory.push(order[0]);
  }
  const observer=new MutationObserver(update);
  const phaseNode=document.getElementById('racePhase');
  const eventNode=document.getElementById('phaseCaption');
  observer.observe(stage,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  if(phaseNode)observer.observe(phaseNode,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
  if(eventNode)observer.observe(eventNode,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  // Position changes can happen without a phase-caption change. Read snapshots only, never write gameplay state.
  let sampling=null;
  const syncSampling=()=>{
    const active=stage.classList.contains('on')&&!document.hidden;
    if(active&&!sampling){update();sampling=setInterval(update,650)}
    else if(!active&&sampling){clearInterval(sampling);sampling=null}
  };
  const samplingGate=new MutationObserver(syncSampling);
  samplingGate.observe(stage,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',syncSampling);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{if(sampling)clearInterval(sampling);samplingGate.disconnect();observer.disconnect()},{once:true});
  syncSampling();
  update();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',mount,{once:true});else mount();
})();
</script>

#raceScreen.gh-cinema .raceBg::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 49% 27%,#f4bd7a80 0,transparent 48%),repeating-linear-gradient(178deg,transparent 0 57px,#fff9db19 59px 61px,transparent 62px 140px);opacity:.65}
#raceScreen.gh-cinema .raceBg::after{inset:47% -10% 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b29366a6,#33271e 37%,#151319 100%),repeating-linear-gradient(176deg,#fff2d611 0 1px,transparent 2px 56px);border-top:3px solid #d6c5a157;transform:perspective(350px) rotateX(14deg);box-shadow:inset 0 22px 22px #0007}
